segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. Last time you said the main thing was getting the safety team out of spreadsheets before the September audit. Are you still looking at 38 users, or did that change?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It changed a little. We have 41 confirmed, and I want 5 extra seats for supervisors who only review reports. So 46 total.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 46 seats. For the standard plan, that puts the annual subscription at $31,280, and implementation is a one-time $4,500. That includes the admin training and importing your last 18 months of inspection data.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. The subscription number is fine. On implementation, can we split that out as a separate line item? Finance wants services separated from software on the invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that's normal. The order form will show subscription and implementation separately, and the invoice will match that. Payment terms would be net 30 unless you need something different.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Net 30 works. What about timing? If we sign by August 9, when can we actually have people logging in?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: If signed by August 9, kickoff would be August 13, data import the week of August 19, and your first admin training on August 22. Your team could start using it in production August 26.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. We do need the contract to be 12 months, not 36. We may expand next year, but I can't commit beyond one year right now.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I'll set it as a 12-month initial term, August 26, 2024 through August 25, 2025, with 46 seats. No auto-increase language, just standard renewal notice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy procurement. If the numbers match what we discussed, I can get it signed this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send the order form this afternoon with the two line items, net 30, and the August 26 go-live target. Anything else you want reflected before I send it?
